name: Feelory
summary: Explore what you feel, make room to reflect, and build a richer emotional vocabulary. Personal by design, local by default.
headline: Find words for what you feel.
compatibility: Made for iPhone and iPad, with support for compatible Macs through Designed for iPad.

features.title: There is more to a feeling than its name.
paragraphs: Explore 128 emotions across eight families. Find definitions, everyday examples, body sensations, and nearby feelings.
Search by a word or a sensation. Begin with the emotion wheel when you know the shape of a feeling before its name.

media.name: phone-explore
media.alt: Feelory's emotion explorer with family filters, a feeling of the day, and definitions.

features.caption: Explore by name, emotion family, or body sensation.

features.title: Make room for the whole thought.
paragraphs: Write a little or a lot. Choose multiple feeling tags and add intensity when it helps. Your writing saves as a draft while you go.
Optional on-device AI can suggest tags and prompts on supported devices with Apple Intelligence available. It never decides how you feel. Core journaling works without it.

media.name: tablet-reflection
media.alt: Feelory on iPad with synthetic journal entries and multiple tags, including saved AI-tag sparkle styling.

features.caption: Synthetic writing and saved AI-tag provenance are shown. This is not a live AI result.

features.title: A little practice. A richer vocabulary.
paragraphs: Flashcards and quizzes help you get to know nearby feelings. There is no need to get your own emotions "right".
A quick check-in can be just a feeling and an optional note. Reflection reminders, widgets, Shortcuts, and a Control Center control make it easier to pause when the moment is right.

media.name: phone-practice
media.alt: A Feelory flashcard describing Acceptance through a definition, body sensations and an everyday example.

features.caption: Learn a little at a time with flashcards and quizzes.

features.title: Patterns, not scores.
paragraphs: Notice which emotion families appear in your reflections, how pleasantness varies, and when feelings tend to show up.
Insights are invitations to reflect, not diagnoses or judgments. Light and dark appearances make room for different moments.

media.name: phone-insights
media.alt: Feelory in dark appearance, showing emotion-family and pleasantness charts based on synthetic reflections.

features.caption: Illustrative patterns from synthetic reflections, not an assessment.
